sources.fact: LBBD Regulation 19 Cabinet HTML includes the Local Plan site-allocation package within which DG Bamford Road is retained in the adopted plan lineage.
Cabinet approval concerns publication/submission of the Local Plan and is not an individual Bamford Road planning permission.
LBBD states the Local Plan 2037 was adopted on 18 September 2024.
The Local Plan is the starting point for development decision-making and does not itself grant a site permission.
The adopted Local Plan is part of the Development Plan used when assessing applications.
Be First provides current statutory planning services for LBBD.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission; allocation status is not consent.
LBBD's current street-tree schedule contains Bamford Road, supporting street identity only.
A street-name match is not treated as a planning red-line, allocation boundary or HMLR title extent.
Land-charge searches require a site location plan for accurate land/property identification.
Planning, building-control and land-charge services remain separate evidence domains.
No exact current DG residential application/decision was verified from accessible official HTML this wave.

examples.result: DG/Bamford Road allocation lineage is retained without importing inaccessible-PDF detail.
Local Plan adoption is not a Bamford Road planning permission.
Bamford Road street identity is not parcel geometry.
No capacity is imported from an unscreened PDF.
No exact current residential application is guessed.
Brownfield/allocation policy does not waive the permission requirement.
Land-charge location plans are not HMLR title verification.
Promotion remains zero until exact current case, title relation and overlays are verified.
